race.description: Barrington Coast Vets Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: TASMAN DEEL (6) improving Dundeel gelding who looks well placed third up. Was lining up for just the second time when fourth over 1400m at Tamworth with the 59kg. Has the addition of blinkers and a win looks imminent. FASHION SPREE (9) ticks a few boxes for this on the back-up. Drifted back from the outside gate and failed to make an impression when sixth over 1400m at Tuncurry in a Super Maiden. Looking for the trip and gets the claim. Genuine contender. ATADCHEEKY (1) desperate for the mile and can race closer today from the low gate. Chipped away late when fifth over 1400m at Tuncurry in A Super Maiden. Has the addition of blinkers and worth thought. LINDA'S PRINCESS (10) has found some form at her last couple of outings from wide gates. Today is no different and stays in the mix.
